notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check that a joined federate which does not enable Time Regulation can submit an attribute update with a logical timestamp and that the receiver observes the same attribute value, tag, producer, and timestamp through the timestamped reflection API. The test deliberately makes no callback-order, sent/received-order, retraction-validity, or broader time-management claim.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped UpdateAttributeValues from a joined non-regulating federate and FederateAmbassador timestamped ReflectAttributeValues
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped attribute-update and FederateAmbassador timestamped reflection declarations
